data.content:
* * *

## [Cora Sideboard is not at all like the Photos or Description](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69a63992cc4851a651a8ea41)

I purchased the Cora Sideboard and am extremely disappointed with the quality. I expected this item to make a statement in my entry. It does...just not the one I intended to make.

There is no craftsmanship, the sideboard stain looks very unprofessional and the piece is not sturdy. I will not be purchasing anything else from Lulu and Georgia for my home remodel as the pictures and the description of this piece were misleading.

(as an aside...the delivery service was exceptional. For what's THAT worth)

March 2, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 3, 2026

Hi Karen,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us! I’m sorry to hear that you are not satisfied with the quality of your sideboard. The item is eligible for return via freight within 30 days of the delivery date, minus any restocking and original shipping fees. If you would like to proceed with the return, please contact our Customer Experience team at Support@Luluandgeorgia.com, and we’ll be happy to assist you with the process. We sincerely hope you find another style of sideboard that you love in the future!
